transcript.text: I have a security finding to report. This morning I inspected a runtime trace of the CLI and confirmed that it sends repository names and branch names to our company's hosted telemetry endpoint. Public distribution requires telemetry to be off by default, but the standard security scan did not exercise that runtime path, so it wasn't caught by the automated scan. I have not added this finding to the release ticket yet. This will require a telemetry_disablement remediation before we can proceed with public publication.

While preparing next month's staffing report, I confirmed that our current ownership roster has no maintained support rotation designated for a public project. Our operations policy requires exactly two named maintainers and a recurring triage commitment before an internal tool can be published externally. This roster gap has not been raised in the release channel yet, and it needs to be addressed before we can proceed with public publication.
